deviations.consequence: Without it the proxy was a tunnel through the fence (dials as the worker uid inside the admitted cgroup); covered by proxy unit tests, 0 host-local audits live

findings.title: Agent runs poll localhost:8888 (the engine API) and are refused
findings.detail: A task run under enforce polled 127.0.0.1:8888 and [::1]:8888 every ~10 s (temporary diag log, enforce-diag-sample). This is a refused row of the target table; the run kept working. Likely a repo test harness readiness loop aimed at a hatchet-lite that is not there.

findings.title: Three egress-proxy unit tests fail inside a task run
findings.detail: Under the run's NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY the proxy test client goes through the run proxy; the agent re-ran with it unset: 114/114. Not a fence effect (PR #392).

findings.title: Shared policy validator accepts private-range allowlist entries the box proxy always refuses
Counters reset on every table (re)load
findings.detail: The loopback-table counters are since the last load; a by-hand loader run resets them. Read deny counts with that in mind; the verifier prints its own probe windows.
